files.content:
# Pixel Snakes & Ladders

A one-player, offline browser game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. No server, installation, or internet connection is required.

## Rules

Use **Roll the die** to roll from 1 to 6. Land exactly on square 30 to win; a roll that would pass 30 leaves you in place. Ladders climb from 3 to 11, 8 to 17, and 20 to 29. Snakes slide from 14 to 5, 24 to 13, and 28 to 19. The board snakes back and forth across five rows of six squares.

The board and token are drawn with HTML and CSS. The game has no packages, imports, external assets, network requests, iframes, or server code. Use the button with a mouse, Enter, or Space.
